cobblemon_field_investigations.advanceme: Dig up a buried clue and brush it out without breaking it
Analyse a sample in the pocket sequencer
Sample a trace with the Field Kit
Solve an investigation with five stars
Scan a target that turns out to be the suspect you named
Get a Field Kit and open your first case
Marker %s: %s · added to the case file (%s / %s needed)
The disturbed soil was broken: %s is lost, this marker will stay unknown
%s: sample it now with the kit
Take new bearings with the kit
Something is buried here: uncover it with a brush, without breaking the block
%s is right there: battle it or catch it (%s perfect IVs)
You ran within %s blocks of it: the target fled (−1 star, quality %s)
It is a %s%s. %s perfect IVs if you catch it: approach without running
The traces lie on the bottom of the water and the target lives in it: bring something to dive and to cross. Head to the zone with your kit, vials and a brush
The traces are on tree trunks and up in the treetops: look up. Head to the zone with your kit, vials and a brush
Every remain is buried here: dig carefully and brush each one out. Head to the zone with your kit, vials and a brush
The suspects all look alike and one more analysis result is required, but the specimen has its hidden ability. Head to the zone with your kit, vials and a brush
The samples are frozen and fragile: each one holds one dose fewer. Head to the zone with your kit, vials and a brush
The traces are on rock faces, scattered across a much wider zone. Head to the zone with your kit, vials and a brush
Cries carry poorly here: your bearings will be much less precise, take more of them. Head to the zone with your kit, vials and a brush
Its traces only show at night, and it only cries and comes out after dark. Head to the zone with your kit, vials and a brush
This one never stays long: it moves twice as often during the hunt, and its lair is farther away. Head to the zone with your kit, vials and a brush
This one senses you from much farther away: you will have to scan it from a long distance. Head to the zone with your kit, vials and a brush
A cave species: its traces and its lair are underground. The kit radar gives the depth; bring torches and a pickaxe. Head to the zone with your kit and vials
%s invites you to join their investigation: open your kit, Team tab
That player is offline, already on a case, or the target is already flushed out
In the field, right-click with the kit to pick up its cry and get a fix on its position
You need a field kit to sample it
Traces have been reported: head to the zone with your kit, vials and a brush
No usable report around here, try somewhere else
The target sleeps during the day: take your bearings at night
The traces of a nocturnal target can only be sampled at night
Too old: it crumbles under your fingers
It does not belong to your investigation
Move at least %s blocks before taking another bearing
The sample is destroyed: this marker will stay unknown · quality %s
You need a field kit on you (pocket sequencer) to analyse it
· every trace is sampled, off to the sequencer
You came within %s blocks before scanning it: the target fled (−1 star, quality %s)
Your earlier bearings are no longer reliable
The target died before you could defeat or catch it: it does not count. Another one has been reported nearby, take new bearings
No more than %s investigators on one case
This sample matches no investigation in progress
Spot it and scan it from afar (hold right-click with the kit, crosshair on it). Stay more than %s blocks away until it is identified
You need an empty vial to take a sample
cobblemon_field_investigations.fix.align: Bearings too aligned: move well off to the side
cobblemon_field_investigations.fix.contr: The bearings contradict each other: take another one further away
cobblemon_field_investigations.fix.two: You need at least two bearings taken far apart to get a fix
cobblemon_field_investigations.sample.he: Right-click with a field kit on you to analyse it
cobblemon_field_investigations.ui.7the_t: §7The target only comes out after dark.
cobblemon_field_investigations.ui.7trace: §7Traces on trunks and up in the
cobblemon_field_investigations.ui.8_one_: §8(one star = no perfect IV, five = four)
cobblemon_field_investigations.ui.a_fail: A failure costs no star: the bearing is only less precise.
A failure damages the sample: a single dose, and half a star lost.
A failure loses one dose of the sample, and half a star.
cobblemon_field_investigations.ui.a_loca: A local Pokémon walks past the trace. Follow it with the viewfinder and click when it is sharp (green viewfinder). Three photos before dark.
cobblemon_field_investigations.ui.at_eac: At each node, take the branch that matches the sample.
cobblemon_field_investigations.ui.click_: Click a strip to stop it once its three bands are well apart, but before the solvent reaches the top.
Click on the side of the hold as it crosses the light band. The pace picks up.
Click (or Space) when the needle crosses the green zone. Three good stops; the zone shrinks and the rotor speeds up.
Click the lane identical to the sample (smp.): position, thickness and brightness of every band matter. Three gels; two mistakes at most.
Click the slots to pick the 4 bases, then Read. You have 6 reads to find the sequence.
Click two fragments to swap them. In the right order, the last 2 bases of each fragment are the first 2 of the next.
Click when the ruler touches the requested edge.
Click when the ruler touches the left edge of the footprint, then the right, top and bottom. Two bad measurements spoil the reading.
cobblemon_field_investigations.ui.darken: Darkened stones still carry weight. Dark notched ones take three hits.
cobblemon_field_investigations.ui.drag_t: Drag the shells into the box on the right. Debris falling into it, or a shell pushed into the bin on the left, counts as a mistake.
cobblemon_field_investigations.ui.each_s: Each star you keep (5 at best) past the first gives the caught Pokémon a perfect IV, and better loot.
cobblemon_field_investigations.ui.every_: Every bite leaves its signature. Slide the cast beneath the jaw until each fang finds its hollow, then press it home.
Every trace is a blend of known inks. Let the solvent climb, lift the rack once you can read the sample, then name the two references it is made of.
cobblemon_field_investigations.ui.everyo: Everyone samples and analyses for the same case. Stars are shared; loot and experience go to each player.
cobblemon_field_investigations.ui.focus_: Focus with the knobs (<< >> coarse, < > fine). Once the image is sharp, click the cell that has two nuclei.
cobblemon_field_investigations.ui.follow: Follow the trace with the viewfinder and click when it is sharp (green viewfinder). Three photos before the light fades.
cobblemon_field_investigations.ui.free_t: Free the glowing stone at the very bottom. You can only pull a stone nothing rests on: start from the top.
cobblemon_field_investigations.ui.give_t: Give the base that pairs with the big slot (A with T, C with G) before the bar runs out. Buttons or keys A, T, C, G.
cobblemon_field_investigations.ui.go_dow: Go down the tree: at each fork, click the branch that carries one of the sample's traits (its card is on the right).
cobblemon_field_investigations.ui.grab_a: Grab a shell and throw it into the box on the right. Time is short, but debris knocked into the box or a shell in the bin is a mistake.
cobblemon_field_investigations.ui.hold_t: Hold the click and rub the whole purple stain. Do not go back over a spot that is already clear: the swab would be contaminated.
Hold the click, from top to bottom.
Hold the click on the starting dot, then follow the groove to the bottom without straying. Three scratches; three slips damage the reading.
Hold the click on the glowing trace to fill the vial. The current moves it, and your air is running out.
Hold the click: sweep the soil in the middle.
Hold the click: sweep the soil to uncover 90 % of the clue before the bar runs out. A rough stroke damages it (three snags at most).
Hold the click to draw liquid, release when the level is in the green zone. Three right doses to get; three faults damage the sample.
Hold the click to heat, let go to cool down. Keep the temperature in the green range without reaching the red.
Hold the click to shake the sieve, in bursts: if the shaking gauge fills up, a fragment falls through.
cobblemon_field_investigations.ui.holds_: Holds scroll down the trunk. Click left or right, on the side of the hold, when it passes through the light band.
cobblemon_field_investigations.ui.if_you: If you get close before identifying it, it runs away.
cobblemon_field_investigations.ui.in_the: In the field with the kit
cobblemon_field_investigations.ui.invite: invites you: see the Team tab
invites you to join their investigation.
cobblemon_field_investigations.ui.ivs_an: IVs and loot by your stars
cobblemon_field_investigations.ui.let_go: Let go before the gauge is full.
cobblemon_field_investigations.ui.line_t: Line the tweezers up with a fibre and click the moment they close. They beat faster and faster.
cobblemon_field_investigations.ui.memori: Memorise the colour, then recreate it from memory by mixing the reagents. You need at least 85 % likeness. Three flasks; two fails at most.
cobblemon_field_investigations.ui.move_t: Move the mouse left and right to tune the filter. Keep the cry clear long enough: the right frequency drifts.
cobblemon_field_investigations.ui.no_clo: No closed case yet. Every solved investigation will be filed here.
cobblemon_field_investigations.ui.no_pla: No player without a case within 64 blocks.
cobblemon_field_investigations.ui.object: Objects push each other: clear the way before bringing a shell over.
cobblemon_field_investigations.ui.only_o: Only one of the three casts matches the bite. Pick it, slide it until every tooth faces its hollow, then fit it.
cobblemon_field_investigations.ui.only_t: Only the lead investigator (★) can invite.
cobblemon_field_investigations.ui.open_a: Open a case to invite teammates, or wait for a lead investigator to invite you.
Open an investigation to get traces to sample (kit, empty vials, brush), then cross out the suspects that do not fit yourself (right-click).
cobblemon_field_investigations.ui.pick_u: Pick up the six eggshell shards among the twigs, leaves and pebbles before the bar runs out. Three mistakes at most.
cobblemon_field_investigations.ui.pour_u: Pour until the liquid turns bright pink. Squirt at first, then go drop by drop as soon as it blushes: two drops too many and it fails.
cobblemon_field_investigations.ui.put_th: Put the spout over a hollow and hold the click to pour plaster. Fill each hollow up to the green band without going over the line.
cobblemon_field_investigations.ui.spinni: Spinning, the sample sorts itself into layers. Brake so that the marked tube comes to rest under the window: the rotor coasts a while before it stops.
cobblemon_field_investigations.ui.stable: Stable (teal) and unstable (red) crystals glow for a moment: memorise them, then sample the stable ones without touching the red ones. Three faults at most.
cobblemon_field_investigations.ui.stains: Stains only glow under the beam. A click on nothing drains the battery.
cobblemon_field_investigations.ui.start_: Start at the top: at each fork, follow the branch whose symbol matches the sample, then click the box you end up on.
cobblemon_field_investigations.ui.stay_o: Stay on the trace. 40% air left at the end: one extra dose.
cobblemon_field_investigations.ui.stop_i: Stop in the green band, just under the line.
cobblemon_field_investigations.ui.sweep_: Sweep the ground with the lamp: stains only show inside the beam. Click each one before the battery runs out.
cobblemon_field_investigations.ui.swing_: Swing from boulder to boulder and slip down to the traces without ever grazing the rock.
cobblemon_field_investigations.ui.the_ca: The canopy keeps its secrets high. Catch each hold as it reaches your hands, let dead wood go by, hang on to the vines, and climb to the trace.
cobblemon_field_investigations.ui.the_cl: The closer you are, the more accurate the bearing.
cobblemon_field_investigations.ui.the_di: The dish is only visible for a moment: count the colonies, then pick the right number. Three dishes; two mistakes at most.
cobblemon_field_investigations.ui.the_ea: The earth keeps what it buried. Brush it away gently, listen for what sounds hollow, and bring the three shards back to the light.
cobblemon_field_investigations.ui.the_gr: The green zone shrinks and the suction speeds up with each dose.
cobblemon_field_investigations.ui.the_ic: The ice only melts in the green range. It drifts: follow it.
cobblemon_field_investigations.ui.the_mu: The mud remembers a passing paw. Pour the plaster into each hollow, right to the brim: it keeps falling after you stop.
cobblemon_field_investigations.ui.the_pr: The program gets one step longer each cycle.
cobblemon_field_investigations.ui.the_sm: The small grey mark shows the minimum gap between two bands.
cobblemon_field_investigations.ui.the_ta: The target is in sight. Keep your distance and scan it: hold right-click with the kit, crosshair on the Pokémon, for three seconds.
cobblemon_field_investigations.ui.the_ti: The tips turn green when they grip.
cobblemon_field_investigations.ui.there_: There it is: battle it or catch it.
cobblemon_field_investigations.ui.they_a: They are buried anywhere: brush around to find them.
cobblemon_field_investigations.ui.throw_: Throw the shells: they keep their momentum and knock into whatever is in the way.
cobblemon_field_investigations.ui.trust_: Trust the sound: the higher it gets, the closer you are.
cobblemon_field_investigations.ui.tune_f: Tune frequency, amplitude and phase until your curve (blue) overlaps the sample's (grey), before the bar runs out.
cobblemon_field_investigations.ui.walk_d: Walk, don't run: a few blocks away, it will be flushed out.
cobblemon_field_investigations.ui.watch_: Watch the sequence of temperature steps, then repeat it by clicking the buttons in the same order. Three cycles; two mistakes at most.
cobblemon_field_investigations.ui.white_: White: your bearings. Bright line: bearing heard, dark lines: margin of error. Yellow circle: likely area.
cobblemon_field_investigations.ui.you_ma: You may lift the swab and start again elsewhere.
cobblemon_field_investigations.ui.you_wi: You will work on their case, and get your own loot and experience.
item.cobblemon_field_investigations.fiel: All-in-one: case file, sampling, pocket sequencer, tracking, scanner
Right-click: case file · on a trace: sample it (empty vial needed) · buried clue: brush
